item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. High temperatures this afternoon reach between thirty-eight and forty-one degrees under cloudy to mostly cloudy skies, with rain likely across the region and a mix of rain and snow possible in some areas. Tonight, lows fall to between thirty and thirty-two degrees with continued cloudy skies and a good chance of rain and snow, including periods of light snow especially west of the lake. Expect precipitation to be widespread today and tonight, with most areas seeing rain and some locations picking up a dusting of snow overnight.
